# TerminalOne Feature Manifest

**Framework:** ShellFish parity backlog (browser-terminal subset)
**Target:** 20 features mapped from ShellFish capabilities that can be implemented in a browser terminal emulator. Implemented one at a time with regression verification (`npm test`).
**Baseline:** all tests passing before feature work begins.
**Final verification:** `npm test` PASS on port 11013.

## Out of scope (requires native iOS/macOS)
- SSH client / host management (TerminalOne runs a local PTY; remote hosts are out of scope)
- Secure Enclave / FIDO2 / certificates
- iCloud Keychain sync
- Files.app / Finder integration
- Mosh protocol
- tmux GUI thumbnails / Handoff
- Shortcuts integration
- Widgets / Live Activities
- Drag-and-drop of real files over SSH
- Cloud server launch (DigitalOcean / Hetzner)
